subject.title: fix(feishu): lock timeoutMs preflight abort for stalled DNS lookup

question: Should Feishu app registration retain current `AbortSignal.timeout()` ownership, or return timeout ownership to the guard's top-level `timeoutMs` contract?
rationale: Current `main` and this PR now encode different timeout owners, and the correct regression assertion depends on which architecture the Feishu owner intends to preserve.

options.title: Keep Current Timeout Owner
options.body: Retain `AbortSignal.timeout()` on current `main` and rewrite or close the test so it verifies the supported current API and diagnostic contract.

options.title: Restore Guard Ownership
options.body: Change production back to the guard's top-level `timeoutMs` path and add an integration assertion for the exact `request timed out` diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Keep Current Timeout Owner
recommendation.body: Retain `AbortSignal.timeout()` on current `main` and rewrite or close the test so it verifies the supported current API and diagnostic contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin explicitly identifies this handle as its community owner.
